title: Landing dispersion x terrain
label: SOURCE-BASED · UNVALIDATED
description: Share of sampled landing outcomes under an assumed dispersion: k of 20 maps on which the landed point passes visibility and slope.

dims.name: R_slope
dims.label: Landing slope limit over 100 m (ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION)

dims.name: D_dispersion
dims.label: Assumed landing dispersion
value_labels: elliptical 1-sigma 60 m x 20 m, major axis 30 deg from grid north

dims.name: k
dims.label: Clone maps (of 20) on which the sampled point passes all requirements
dims.note: k of N maps is not a probability; the clones are deterministic alternates (PGDA 78 error realizations).

samples.label: share of sampled landing outcomes under an assumed dispersion

share_pass_all_20_pct.label: share of sampled landing outcomes under an assumed dispersion: passing on all 20 maps

share_pass_nominal_pct.label: share of sampled landing outcomes under an assumed dispersion: passing on the nominal map

share_outside_field_pct.label: samples beyond the +-200 m field (not counted as pass or fail)

summary.method: nearest 25 m cell; pass = team visibility AND 100 m slope < limit, per map
summary.caveat: k of N maps is not a probability; the clones are deterministic alternates (PGDA 78 error realizations).

limitations: Share of sampled landing outcomes under an assumed dispersion; not a probability of success.
Field at 25 m (prompt asks 5-10 m); nearest-cell assignment.
